paragraphs.text:
A gasp from the rear tells you that Bernard has been hit. You 
glance over your shoulder, to see him stagger on stiff legs and 
then fall. The creatures scramble toward him.

To stop and help Bernard, go to 332. To race on with Charlie, go 
to 153.
